proposals.before: Tang Bin, Sun Zhixu, Lu Longqi, and Zhang Boxing
proposals.after: Tang Bin, his grandson Zhixu, Lu Longqi, and Zhang Boxing
proposals.reason: In the heading 湯斌孫之旭, 孫 marks kinship (grandson), not the surname Sun; 之旭 is Tang Bin's grandson listed for an attached biography.

proposals.before: Tang Bin, Sun Zhixu, Lu Longqi, Zhang Boxing
proposals.after: Tang Bin, grandson Zhixu, Lu Longqi, Zhang Boxing
proposals.reason: The literal line likewise treats 孫之旭 as a surname-plus-given name instead of 'grandson Zhixu'.

proposals.before: Many prefectural and circuit posts stood empty, and the emperor wanted men of both learning and integrity who could turn scholarship to practical use. From the Hanlin Academy he chose Chen Huang, Huang Zhilin, Wang Wujiu, Yang Sisheng, Lan Run, Wang Shunnian, Fan Zhou, Ma Yeeng, Shen Quan, and Bin—ten in all.
proposals.after: Many prefectural and circuit posts stood empty, and the emperor wanted men of both learning and integrity who could turn scholarship to practical use. From the Hanlin Academy he chose Chen Huang, Huang Zhilin, Wang Wujiu, Yang Sisheng, Lan Run, Wang Shunnian, Fan Zhou, Ma Yezeng, Shen Quan, and Bin—ten in all.
proposals.reason: 馬燁曾 is Ma Yezeng (Yèzēng); 'Ma Yeeng' is a corrupted romanization.

proposals.before: At the time many prefectural and circuit posts were vacant; the emperor, urgently needing men, sought those combining literary and moral excellence, taking learning as practical statecraft, and selected Hanlin officials, obtaining Chen Huang, Huang Zhilin, Wang Wujiu, Yang Sisheng, Lan Run, Wang Shunnian, Fan Zhou, Ma Yeeng, Shen Quan, and Bin, ten in all.
proposals.after: At the time many prefectural and circuit posts were vacant; the emperor, urgently needing men, sought those combining literary and moral excellence, taking learning as practical statecraft, and selected Hanlin officials, obtaining Chen Huang, Huang Zhilin, Wang Wujiu, Yang Sisheng, Lan Run, Wang Shunnian, Fan Zhou, Ma Yezeng, Shen Quan, and Bin, ten in all.
proposals.reason: Same corrupted romanization of 馬燁曾 as Ma Yeeng in the literal line.

proposals.before: In 1682 he was named chief compiler of the Ming History and made left vice director of the Secretariat.
proposals.after: In 1682 he was named chief compiler of the Ming History and made Left Mentor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
proposals.reason: 左庶子 is the Left Mentor (shuzi) in the heir apparent's household administration, not a vice director of the Secretariat.

proposals.before: In the twenty-first year, he was appointed chief compiler of the Ming History and promoted to left vice director of the Secretariat.
proposals.after: In the twenty-first year, he was appointed chief compiler of the Ming History and promoted to Left Mentor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
proposals.reason: The literal line repeats the same mistranslation of 左庶子.

proposals.before: Songgotu was in power, and Yu Guozhu attached himself to him.
proposals.after: Mingzhu was in power, and Yu Guozhu attached himself to him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu (Mingju), not Songgotu (索額圖).

proposals.before: At the time Songgotu held power, and Guozhu attached himself to him.
proposals.after: At the time Mingzhu held power, and Guozhu attached himself to him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: Provincial Treasurer Gong Qixuan was impeached for corruption by Censor Lu Longqi, but Guozhu bribed Songgotu and the case was softened;
proposals.after: Provincial Treasurer Gong Qixuan was impeached for corruption by Censor Lu Longqi, but Guozhu bribed Mingzhu and the case was softened;
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: Provincial Treasurer Gong Qixuan was convicted of corruption and impeached by Censor Lu Longqi; through Guozhu's bribe to Songgotu the case was eased;
proposals.after: Provincial Treasurer Gong Qixuan was convicted of corruption and impeached by Censor Lu Longqi; through Guozhu's bribe to Mingzhu the case was eased;
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: After the Jiangnan tax remissions, Guozhu sent word that Songgotu deserved gratitude from the region and demanded a payoff. Bin refused.
proposals.after: After the Jiangnan tax remissions, Guozhu sent word that Mingzhu deserved gratitude from the region and demanded a payoff. Bin refused.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: When Jiangnan taxes were remitted, Guozhu sent someone to tell Bin that it was all Songgotu's doing and Jiangnan people ought to repay him, demanding a bribe; Bin did not respond.
proposals.after: When Jiangnan taxes were remitted, Guozhu sent someone to tell Bin that it was all Mingzhu's doing and Jiangnan people ought to repay him, demanding a bribe; Bin did not respond.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: At the triennial evaluation, officials streamed gold to Songgotu's door, but none of Bin's staff did.
proposals.after: At the triennial evaluation, officials streamed gold to Mingzhu's door, but none of Bin's staff did.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: At the grand assessment, outer officials bearing gold to Songgotu's gate never ceased, but among Bin's subordinates there was none.
proposals.after: At the grand assessment, outer officials bearing gold to Mingzhu's gate never ceased, but among Bin's subordinates there was none.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: Most courtiers sided with Jin Fu to please Songgotu.
proposals.after: Most courtiers sided with Jin Fu to please Mingzhu.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: Court officials curried Songgotu's favor and mostly sided with Jin Fu.
proposals.after: Court officials curried Mingzhu's favor and mostly sided with Jin Fu.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: In the fifth month of 1687, amid drought, Astronomy Bureau clerk Dong Hanchen memorialized criticizing current affairs in terms that implicated the chief ministers. The case went to court debate; Songgotu was terrified and prepared to confess guilt.
proposals.after: In the fifth month of 1687, amid drought, Astronomy Bureau clerk Dong Hanchen memorialized criticizing current affairs in terms that implicated the chief ministers. The case went to court debate; Mingzhu was terrified and prepared to confess guilt.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu (索額圖).

proposals.before: In the fifth month of the twenty-sixth year there was no rain; Astronomy Bureau Attendant Dong Hanchen submitted a memorial criticizing current affairs, his words encroaching on those in power; it was referred to court deliberation; Songgotu was fearful and about to plead guilty.
proposals.after: In the fifth month of the twenty-sixth year there was no rain; Astronomy Bureau Attendant Dong Hanchen submitted a memorial criticizing current affairs, his words encroaching on those in power; it was referred to court deliberation; Mingzhu was fearful and about to plead guilty.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: Songgotu and Guozhu were enraged, reported Bin's words to the throne, and dredged up a phrase from his Suzhou proclamations—"he loves the people in heart but lacks the means to save them"—as slander. An edict ordered him questioned.
proposals.after: Mingzhu and Guozhu were enraged, reported Bin's words to the throne, and dredged up a phrase from his Suzhou proclamations—"he loves the people in heart but lacks the means to save them"—as slander. An edict ordered him questioned.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: Songgotu and Guozhu grew more resentful, excerpted his words to report upward, and also gathered phrases from Bin's proclamations in Suzhou saying "he has a heart to love the people but no method to save them," treating them as slander; an edict was transmitted to interrogate him.
proposals.after: Mingzhu and Guozhu grew more resentful, excerpted his words to report upward, and also gathered phrases from Bin's proclamations in Suzhou saying "he has a heart to love the people but no method to save them," treating them as slander; an edict was transmitted to interrogate him.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: Songgotu, Guozhu, and their allies hated him fiercely. Had the emperor not favored him a little, Bin's ruin would have been certain.
proposals.after: Mingzhu, Guozhu, and their allies hated him fiercely. Had the emperor not favored him a little, Bin's ruin would have been certain.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: Songgotu, Guozhu, and their faction envied Bin deeply; had the emperor not favored Bin slightly, Bin's disaster would have been beyond reckoning.
proposals.after: Mingzhu, Guozhu, and their faction envied Bin deeply; had the emperor not favored Bin slightly, Bin's disaster would have been beyond reckoning.
proposals.reason: Chinese 明珠 is Mingzhu, not Songgotu.

proposals.before: Sun Zhixu, whose style was Mengsheng,
proposals.after: His grandson Zhixu, whose style was Mengsheng,
proposals.reason: After the subject's death, 孫之旭 names grandson Zhixu (湯之旭), not a man surnamed Sun.

proposals.before: Sun Zhixu, style name Mengsheng.
proposals.after: His grandson Zhixu, style name Mengsheng.
proposals.reason: 孫之旭 is kinship 孫 plus given name 之旭, not surname Sun.

proposals.before: He was posted to the Baxing Circuit and later promoted to left vice commissioner of communications in the capital.
proposals.after: He was posted to the Bachang Circuit and later promoted to left vice commissioner of communications in the capital.
proposals.reason: 霸昌道 is the Bachang (Baoding-Changping) circuit, not Baxing.

proposals.before: He went out as Baxing Circuit commissioner and was promoted within the capital to left vice commissioner of communications.
proposals.after: He went out as Bachang Circuit commissioner and was promoted within the capital to left vice commissioner of communications.
proposals.reason: 霸昌 is Bachang, not Baxing.

proposals.before: Shuntian Prefect Wei Jiji was touring the capital region and reported that the people were deeply alarmed at the prospect of Longqi's banishment. He was spared.
proposals.after: Shuntian Prefect Wei Jiqi was touring the capital region and reported that the people were deeply alarmed at the prospect of Longqi's banishment. He was spared.
proposals.reason: 衛既齊 is Wei Jiqi (既 Jì, 齊 Qí); the packet romanization Jiji misreads the given name.

proposals.before: It happened that Shuntian Prefect Wei Jiji was touring the capital region; returning he reported the people's hearts were anxious, fearing Longqi's distant banishment, and so he was spared.
proposals.after: It happened that Shuntian Prefect Wei Jiqi was touring the capital region; returning he reported the people's hearts were anxious, fearing Longqi's distant banishment, and so he was spared.
proposals.reason: Same romanization error of 衛既齊 as Wei Jiji instead of Wei Jiqi in the literal English.

proposals.before: Governors were then ordered to recommend able officials, but Boxing did not nominate anyone.
proposals.after: Governors were then ordered to recommend able officials, but Boxing was not among those recommended.
proposals.reason: 不與 means Boxing was not included in the governors' recommendations, not that he declined to nominate others.

proposals.before: Penghe proposed that former governors Yu Zhun and Sigong repay 160,000 taels and that the rest be covered by salary deductions.
proposals.after: Penghe proposed that former governor Yu Zhun and Sigong repay 160,000 taels and that the rest be covered by salary deductions.
proposals.reason: 前任巡撫 modifies 於準 only; 思恭 is the provincial treasurer already named, not a former governor.

proposals.before: Penghe requested that former governors Yu Zhun and Sigong repay one hundred sixty thousand, the remainder covered by salaries and rations.
proposals.after: Penghe requested that former governor Yu Zhun and Sigong repay one hundred sixty thousand, the remainder covered by salaries and rations.
proposals.reason: Same error as the idiomatic line: 前任巡撫 does not cover 思恭.

proposals.before: When the ministry ordered a hunt for remnants of the pirate Zheng Jin's gang, Chongming naval forces seized a fishing boat whose crew were Fujian men posing as Huating natives. The license proved Yuanlong had obtained it for them, and Boxing sought a full prosecution.
proposals.after: When the ministry ordered a hunt for remnants of the pirate Zheng Jinxin's gang, Chongming naval forces seized a fishing boat whose crew were Fujian men posing as Huating natives. The license proved Yuanlong had obtained it for them, and Boxing sought a full prosecution.
proposals.reason: 鄭盡心 is Zheng Jinxin; rendering Jin alone drops 盡心.

proposals.before: His son Shizai, styled Youqu,
proposals.after: His son Shizai was styled Youqu.
proposals.reason: The idiomatic English is a truncated clause ending in a comma rather than a complete sentence matching the Chinese biographical formula.

proposals.before: The Mangdao sluice in Jiangdu was the key junction where the Huai, Yellow, and Gaoyou rivers entered the Yangzi, and summer floods ran high.
proposals.after: The Mangdao sluice in Jiangdu was the key junction where the Huai, Yellow, Gaoyou, and Baoying rivers entered the Yangzi, and summer floods ran high.
proposals.reason: Chinese 高、寶 names both Gaoyou and Baoying; the idiomatic rendering drops Baoying while the literal keeps it.

proposals.before: The emperor ordered the execution of Assistant Prefect Li Kun and Garrison Commander Zhang Bin for flood negligence and made Shizai witness it before restoring him to office.
proposals.after: The emperor ordered the execution of Assistant Prefect Li Tun and Garrison Commander Zhang Bin for flood negligence and made Shizai witness it before restoring him to office.
proposals.reason: The given name 焞 is Tun, not Kun; the packet English is corrected here as an editorial proposal without changing surfaces.

proposals.before: The emperor ordered execution of Assistant Prefect Li Kun and Garrison Commander Zhang Bin for negligence in flood defense, had Shizai witness the execution, and after it was done released him.
proposals.after: The emperor ordered execution of Assistant Prefect Li Tun and Garrison Commander Zhang Bin for negligence in flood defense, had Shizai witness the execution, and after it was done released him.
proposals.reason: Literal English likewise renders 李焞 as Li Kun; 焞 corresponds to Tun.

claimRetractions.reason: Songgotu was produced only by mistranslating 明珠; the source names Mingzhu, already claimed as c0162, and does not support Songgotu as an alias.
The alternate English name Songgotu was created solely by the bad translation of 明珠; no source alias 索額圖 appears here.
